[Verse]
[female vocal, dreamy]
Rearview mirror captures a ghost of the skyline
Flickering lights fading into the gray
I packed my shadows in a suitcase of memories
Taking the highway where the secrets stay
The engine is humming a low steady rhythm
Chasing the border of a different life
Leaving the pavement where our stories were written
Trading the noise for the silence of night

[Chorus]
[synthwave, driving beat]
Running on neon and a heart made of wire
Leaving the ashes to feed the fire
I don't know where the road ends tonight
Just moving toward the morning light

[Verse]
[female vocal, dreamy]
The radio's static is a lullaby blowing
Past the diners and the signs of the old
I'm shedding the weight of the years I was holding
Watching the skyline turn into gold
Every exit is a chance to start over
Every mile is a page that I finally turn
No more anchors to pull me back under
Just the open road and the bridges I burn
